evidence: A bound consumer could be classified as owner review when review scope was requested; consumer binding now takes precedence and forces the exact portal project.
Visual consumer claims previously accepted additional projects; claims now require exactly project-infinitum.
Retrieval scope checks did not validate all projection provenance fields; the full projection contract is now validated before a match is returned.
The database assistant identifier glob admitted non-hex suffix characters; the constraint now rejects every non-hex character after oauth-.
Deployment automation uses a domain-separated SHA-256 derivative of the resolver secret; the raw resolver token and foreign keys are denied before packet parsing or mutation.
